cases_doc: D.3 calibration slate — cobrapy fba_steady_state. Line: the status-gate + relative-not-absolute (C1-hole F4).
label_provenance: pre-registered by the build chat 2026-07-19 from the ruled card (F1-F4); in->trust, out->defer.
substrate_text: COBRApy + GLPK running constraint-based FLUX-BALANCE ANALYSIS (a deterministic linear program) on a genome-scale metabolic model at STEADY STATE. FILTER-class: the growth it reports is a feasible steady-state optimum, a RELATIVE screen for comparing models/conditions, NOT a measured in-vivo growth rate. Baked models: e_coli_core, iML1515. Returns ONE scalar growth_rate, GATED ON SOLVER STATUS: only an 'optimal' solve yields a number; an infeasible or unbounded solve returns no number (the stale objective is never surfaced). THE KNOWN GAP: the FBA optimum is a feasible steady-state upper bound under the model's stoichiometry and media, NOT a measured growth rate — no regulation, no kinetics, no dynamics.
envelope_text: IN-REGIME: a well-formed baked model, a feasible LP (status optimal), the objective read as a RELATIVE feasibility/growth screen. OUT-OF-REGIME: a demand for the ABSOLUTE in-vivo growth rate; an infeasible/over-constrained solve; a kinetic/transient/regulatory question; the FBA optimum read as a measured growth rate.

gate_cases.experiment: Run FBA on the e_coli_core model with its default biomass objective and report the maximum growth as a relative feasibility screen.
gate_cases.note: Dead-centre: a well-formed baked model, a feasible optimal LP, growth used as a relative screen.
gate_cases.right_instrument: the deterministic FBA optimum of the baked model, as a relative screen.

gate_cases.experiment: Run FBA on the genome-scale iML1515 model with its default biomass objective and report the optimal growth as a relative screen.
gate_cases.note: In-regime: a feasible optimal LP on the genome-scale baked model, used relatively.
gate_cases.right_instrument: the deterministic FBA optimum of iML1515, as a relative screen.

gate_cases.experiment: Compare the FBA optimal growth of e_coli_core against iML1515 as a RELATIVE ranking of the two models' feasible growth capacities.
gate_cases.note: In-regime: a relative comparison — exactly the screen the substrate provides.
gate_cases.right_instrument: two deterministic FBA optima compared relatively.

gate_cases.experiment: Run FBA on e_coli_core and report whether the model can achieve a non-zero feasible growth (a feasibility check) with the optimal value.
gate_cases.note: In-regime: a feasibility/relative-growth read, status optimal.
gate_cases.right_instrument: the deterministic feasibility + optimal value of the baked model.

gate_cases.experiment: Report the e_coli_core biomass flux at the FBA optimum as the model's predicted maximum steady-state growth capacity (relative, not measured).
gate_cases.note: In-regime: the optimum read as steady-state capacity, explicitly relative — the exact framing the card gates on.
gate_cases.right_instrument: the deterministic FBA optimum framed as steady-state capacity, relatively.

gate_cases.experiment: Report the e_coli_core FBA optimal growth as the strain's ACTUAL measured in-vivo doubling rate in a bioreactor.
gate_cases.note: C1-hole F4, direct: the FBA optimum is a feasible upper bound, NOT a measured in-vivo rate. Reading it as measured growth is out-of-envelope.
gate_cases.right_instrument: a measured growth-rate assay — FBA does not measure in-vivo growth.

gate_cases.experiment: Constrain the biomass reaction to a lower bound above the model's achievable maximum, then report the growth from the resulting (infeasible) solve.
gate_cases.note: Status-gate (F1): the solve is infeasible; no trustworthy growth exists. A number here would be the stale objective.
gate_cases.right_instrument: an infeasible over-constrained solve — no growth to report.

gate_cases.experiment: Use the FBA growth to determine how the strain's growth changes over TIME after a nutrient shift (a transient/kinetic prediction).
gate_cases.note: Out of regime: FBA is steady-state; it says nothing about time-resolved/kinetic dynamics.
gate_cases.right_instrument: a dynamic/kinetic model (dFBA/ODE) — outside steady-state FBA.

gate_cases.experiment: Report the FBA optimum as the strain's growth accounting for its transcriptional REGULATION of the pathways involved.
gate_cases.note: Out of regime: FBA has no regulation; the optimum ignores regulatory constraints the claim asserts.
gate_cases.right_instrument: a regulatory/constraint-integrated model — FBA encodes no regulation.

gate_cases.experiment: Report the exact numeric in-vivo growth rate (per hour) a wet-lab experiment WILL measure, from the FBA optimum.
gate_cases.note: C1-hole F4: an absolute-measured-rate claim; the FBA optimum is a relative feasible bound, not a wet-lab prediction.
gate_cases.right_instrument: a wet-lab growth measurement — not an FBA output.
